summary: Frontend-only verification of the reported session-persistence bug on Home ('/'). The embedded hero navbar in Home.jsx now reads AuthContext correctly. TEST1 (admin), TEST2 (team/coach), TEST3 (logout from Home) and TEST4 (hero smoke on /datos-estadisticas and /noticias) all PASSED. Login modal opened reliably on a normal click (no overlay/timing issue found in this environment).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx hero navbar and the shared Navbar.jsx duplicate the same conditional auth-nav block (user? ADMIN/MI EQUIPO/SALIR : INGRESO/REGISTRO) plus the same nav-link array. Consider extracting a shared <NavAuthActions/> + nav items constant to avoid this class of bug recurring (DRY).

Both Home hero navbar and shared Navbar render data-testid='nav-link-ingreso'; when both are mounted on the same route a testid collision could occur. Currently Home does not render the shared Navbar, so no collision, but keep in mind for future layout changes.
Home.jsx is 558 lines and growing; consider splitting Hero/Gallery/Stats sections into components.
seed_data_creation: None. Logged out of both accounts after testing; no data created or modified.
test_credentials: admin@futuresoccercup.com / FSCAdmin2025! and coach@test.com / Coach2025! both verified working
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow verified via Playwright: click [data-testid=nav-link-ingreso] -> [data-testid=login-modal-overlay] appears within ~1s -> fill login-modal-email/login-modal-password -> login-modal-submit. Admin redirects to /admin, team to /mi-equipo. On Home the embedded navbar is scoped by [data-testid=hero-nav-bar]; scope selectors to it. IMPORTANT: page.goto on '/' with wait_until='networkidle' times out (persistent connections from the chat widget) - use wait_until='domcontentloaded' instead. Also note renderPlaneCrash() splits hero titles into per-character spans, so get_by_text('MARCADOR', exact=True) returns 0; assert visually or via container testid instead.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug RCA (confirmed by code review + reproduction of the fixed state): Home.jsx renders its own hero navbar independent from the shared Navbar.jsx and never consumed useAuth(), so it always rendered INGRESO/REGISTRO, giving the impression the session was lost when navigating back to '/'. The fix (useAuth() + conditional ADMIN/MI EQUIPO/SALIR block) is verified working for both SPA navigation (logo click) and a full hard reload of '/' (cookie-based rehydration keeps ADMIN + SALIR visible). Logout from Home restores INGRESO/REGISTRO immediately.
